name: Apothecary
text: And the last color has arrived!

name: Apothecary
text: Hold on one moment, and I'll get this set up for ya

name: Apothecary
text: Why are you looking at me so queer? That spin jump really made you a fairy, huh?

name: Pierre
text: No. I'm just waiting to hear what fucky shit this plant will make me do

name: Apothecary
text: To be honest I have no clue, first time working with this one.

name: Apothecary
text: I just liked the color and wanted you to fetch it

name: Pierre
text: So you've no idea if this work well for a paint mix!? You asshole

name: Apothecary
text: Well it's not like you risked your life for it or anything

name: Apothecary
text: Anyway I'm finished, be off with you. I've some work to be done

name: Pierre
text: And what kind of work is that?

name: Apothecary
text: I'm about to use these plants...

name: Apothecary
text: 'special properties' to study more in depth matters of the higher plain

name: Pierre
text: ... I just got you your drugs didn't I?
